LESSON: INDUSTRIES IN THE COUNTY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Economic Activities
Topic 4.2: Industries in the County

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Industries in the County
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
